verdict.rationale: Navan has no CLI or headless runner, but it offers machine-to-machine automation. Its API uses an OAuth 2.0 client-credentials flow and exposes retrieval and update endpoints across the expense surface, plus webhooks and async job-status polling, which together allow non-interactive scripted or pipeline use. missing for 10: an official CLI or SDK for headless runs, documented CI/pipeline integration or examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended automation.
